constraints: If document already exists on disk, it is silently overwritten; if it is locked or already open, an error is generated instead.
Passing an empty string for document displays the standard Save As dialog; if the user cancels, a null DocRef is returned and OK is set to 0.
fileType may list several types separated by ';'; pass "*" or ".*" to not filter/screen file types in the save dialog.
The system variable Document is updated with the created document's full pathname, and OK is set to 1 on success / 0 on failure or cancellation.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates (or overwrites) and opens a new document on disk -- or, if document is an empty string, prompts the user via a Save As dialog -- and returns its document reference number.
